nodes.label: Planned isolated Python ML worker
nodes.description: Future asynchronous training, inference, backtesting and drift evaluation with idempotent bounded jobs and disable/rollback switches.
nodes.rationale: Keep heavyweight training separate from user HTTP requests; Python separation is provisional pending workload and cost benchmarking.

nodes.label: Forecast evaluation and governance
nodes.rationale: Time-respecting partitions and rolling backtests prevent future leakage; compare naive baselines, record versions and lineage, calibrate uncertainty, monitor drift and fall back to descriptive reporting.

nodes.label: Forecast tenant isolation
nodes.rationale: Enforce tenant boundaries across feature extraction, training, artifacts, inference, logs and exports; no cross-workspace customer-data training by default.

nodes.label: Human-reviewed forecast decisions
nodes.rationale: Warnings recommend investigation; they must not automatically approve spending, reassign staff or cancel work, and predictions must not modify observed history.
